questionText: Company Apex #26 forfeited 700 shares of Rs. 10 each on which Rs. 7 per share was received. 700 of these shares were reissued as fully paid-up at Rs. 8 per share. What amount is transferred to Capital Reserve Account?

options.text: Share Forfeiture Dr. Rs. 4,900 to Capital Reserve A/c Rs. 4,900
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

1. Allotted shares: 400 * (3/4) = 300 shares.

questionText:
Which of the following statements are correct in relation to the issue of
share capital for public subscription?
(A) The application money should be at least 5% of the face value of the
share.
(B) Calls are to be made as per the provisions of the articles of association.
(C) Where there is no articles of association of its own, the provisions of
Table A will apply.
(D) Calls need not be made on a uniform basis on all shares within the
same class.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid scientific statements erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is true while Statement II contains a factual error.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Statement (A): Application money must be at least 5% of nominal value (Companies Act Sec 39(2)). True.
2. Statement (B): Calls must comply with Articles of Association. True.
3. Statement (C): In absence of own articles, model articles (Table A/Table F) govern calls. True.
4. Statement (D): 'Calls need not be made on a uniform basis on all shares within the same class.' False; Section 49 mandates that calls MUST be made on a uniform basis for all shares of the same class.
5. Therefore, (A), (B), and (C) only are correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
